name: hebb
description: Memory for Claude Code that learns from what actually happened: it catches commands your machine is known to fail on before they run, refuses the ones you banned, and remembers what you told it, across sessions, projects and teammates.

hebb_key.title: Hebb key (optional)
hebb_key.description: Optional. Leave it empty and Hebb keeps its memories on this machine only. Add a free key from https://hebb-site.pages.dev/dashboard.html (Connect to Claude Code) to share memories with your team and across computers. It starts with hebb_live_.
